parole.significato: A tax or fee imposed on foreigners under the Ottoman Empire, especially one considered to be irregular or extortionate.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian avania, from Byzantine Greek ἀβανία (abanía, cfr. modern Greek αβανιά (avaniá) “defamation, slander”), possibly from Arabic خَوَّان (ḵawwān, “unreliable, treacherous”).
